name: global_safety_policy
description: Cross-domain safety rules applied to every action.

rules.description: Content tries to override instructions or exfiltrate data.
rules.reason: Possible prompt injection detected; the proposed action is blocked

rules.description: Any detected destructive action, whatever the planner claims about rollback.
Destructive action that cannot be undone.
rules.reason: Irreversible destructive action requires human approval

rules.description: Planner is unsure about an externally-impactful action.
rules.reason: Low planner confidence on an impactful action; routing to approval

rules.description: Message asks a user for credentials (phishing).
rules.reason: Action requests credentials from a user (phishing pattern); blocked

rules.description: Bulk customer-data export paired with an external destination.
rules.reason: Bulk export of customer data to an external destination is blocked regardless of individual entity severity

rules.description: PII leaving through an external action must be sanitized.
rules.reason: PII in an external action must be redacted before execution

rules.description: Browser form submission is an external side effect.
rules.reason: Browser form submission requires human approval

rules.description: A submit-capable element must not bypass submit policy as a click.
rules.reason: Submit-capable browser controls require the guarded submit path
